description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the NationalityDao in the OrangeHRM system, testing CRUD operations and other methods related to nationality entities within the admin DAO module.

classes.name: NationalityDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the NationalityDao's functionality in managing nationality entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, creating a new NationalityDao object and populating test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testAddNationality
methods.description: Tests adding a new nationality and verifies that it is correctly saved.

methods.name: testEditNationality
methods.description: Tests editing an existing nationality record.

methods.name: testGetNationalityList
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of nationalities with a filter.

methods.name: testGetNationalityById
methods.description: Tests fetching a nationality by its ID.

methods.name: testGetNationalityByName
methods.description: Tests fetching a nationality by name, including case insensitivity and whitespace trimming.

methods.name: testIsExistingNationalityName
methods.description: Checks whether a nationality name exists, case-insensitive and trimmed.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests attempting to delete a non-existing nationality record and expects zero deletions.
